author: fanaticgaming
quote: I'm playing at 30 fps in 2026? Other games would have been crucified by now. It's just for the sake of being the only one in the house, or it's anxiety-inducing, not to mention the bugs I've encountered on the PS5. We really need to be objective. Besides, it took a long time to develop and it still falls short. All that's missing is for everything to be membership-based.
